## Constitution Compliance

- [ ] CHK001 Layer dependencies follow `UI -> business -> execution -> data/driver` direction
- [ ] CHK002 Business data accessed through Repository (`src/data/repos/`), no raw SQL in business code
- [ ] CHK003 All config reads through `get_unified_config()`, no direct file reads
- [ ] CHK004 Cross-module notifications use blinker events (`src/utils/events.py`)
- [ ] CHK005 UI accesses data layer through Service/Bridge, not directly
- [ ] CHK006 Silent-failure paths have corresponding tests (orchestration, events, repository, recovery)

## Architecture Wiring

- [ ] CHK007 If modules/events/orchestration paths were replaced: wiring smoke test added
- [ ] CHK008 If old paths were removed: guard test confirms they are no longer imported
- [ ] CHK009 New events (if any) defined in `src/utils/events.py`
- [ ] CHK010 Agent tool handlers remain stateless (no direct event sending or UI calls)

## Data & Config

- [ ] CHK011 SQLite changes include Repository methods in `src/data/repos/`
- [ ] CHK012 DuckDB `network_requests` reads go through `sql_rewriter` or `FilteredDuckDBConnection`
- [ ] CHK013 New config keys synced across: default values, config template, UI/docs
- [ ] CHK014 Sensitive fields use keyring, not hardcoded in code or config files

## Testing
